hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ "${SDLC_KNOWLEDGE:-}" != off ] && ! grep -qsE '^[[:space:]]*enabled[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*false' .sdlc.toml && ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ "${OS:-}" = Windows_NT ]; then powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex" >/dev/null 2>&1; else curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; fi; exec uv run --no-project "$P" session-start
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec uv run --no-project "$P" pre-edit
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec uv run --no-project "$P" pre-bash
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec uv run --no-project "$P" post-edit
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; exec uv run --no-project "$P" post-bash
